summary: Iteration-16 NextCart pre-checkout integration verified end-to-end. Backend proxy (12/12 pytest cases pass): /api/nextcart/config returns econt/boxnow/pigeon providers, delivery methods with correct prices (econt_office 3.89, boxnow_locker 2.99, pigeon_address 4.59) and 245 phone territories; /api/nextcart/offices returns live Econt offices in Пловдив and BoxNow lockers; /api/nextcart/address-suggestions returns Bulgarian city suggestions; invalid params (destination_type=foo, q<2, mode=xyz) return 422; POST /api/nextcart/event returns 200 and never breaks the flow; bogus provider_key does not crash proxy. Frontend full flow works on desktop 1920: add-to-cart -> cart drawer -> accept terms -> cart-checkout-btn -> precheckout-modal opens with all 3 courier logos; switching couriers changes methods and pc-total updates correctly (BoxNow 51.99, Pigeon 53.59, Econt 52.89 for a 49.00 item); office search returns 25 Econt offices for 'Пловдив'; Pigeon flow shows pc-city with suggestions + pc-street/pc-number; pc-continue disabled until name/last_name/email/phone/office(or city+street) supplied; invalid discount code shows Bulgarian toast 'Невалиден код за отстъпка'; continuing prefills /checkout with name/email/phone/address/city/postal_code, checkout-chosen-delivery card renders 'Еконт · До офис на Еконт / Пловдив Автогара Родопи, ПЛОВДИВ / 3,89 €', checkout-total = 52,89 €; placing the order navigates to /checkout/success/<id>. Admin GET /api/admin/orders shows the new order with shipping_eur=3.89 and total_eur=52.89. Direct MongoDB inspection confirms the full delivery object (provider_key='econt', method_key='econt_office', office{id,name,address,city,postal_code}) is persisted on the order. Mobile 390 regression: cart drawer bbox {x:46.8, y:0, w:343.2, h:844} preserved (same as iter-15). Admin login regression still 200.

minor.issue: _order_view() (server.py L834-891) does not surface the persisted 'delivery' object (provider/method/office) even though it is correctly saved on the order document. Admin listing/detail responses show delivery=null; admin UI will not see the chosen courier/office via this endpoint. shipping_eur is exposed correctly.

action_items: server.py _order_view(): include 'delivery' (provider_key, provider_name, method_key, destination_type, label, office{name,address,city,postal_code}, address) so admin UI/API surfaces the courier + pickup location chosen at pre-checkout.
critical_code_review_comments: PreCheckoutModal.jsx L252: the outer `{true && ( ... )}` wrapper around the discount block is dead code — should be removed.

PreCheckoutModal.jsx L94-95: `contact.email.includes('@')` is a very weak email validation; consider a proper regex or defer to native type=email validity (input has type='email' only for the Field wrapper).
nextcart.py _cached()/_store() share the ttl parameter name but only _store() uses it — _cached's `ttl` argument is unused (dead parameter). Not a bug, just a small tidy-up.

CheckoutPage.jsx L63: when a NextCart pre-checkout selection exists, `finalShipping` still applies the >=100 free-shipping override (`subtotal>=100 ? 0 : shipping`). This can silently zero out the NextCart-paid price on large baskets — likely inconsistent with the merchant intent that the courier price is authoritative once selected in the pre-checkout modal.
server.py _order_view() omits `delivery`, `discount_code`, and any tracking of NextCart method/office in the admin response — see backend_issues.minor.
Iteration-15 open items still valid: /api/files/... HEAD returns 405; ALLOWED_WIDTHS gap; React-Router pattern '/pages/html-sitemap-:kind' regression not retested (per agent-to-agent note).

rca of the issue: The delivery=null in admin orders API is an output serialization gap, not a persistence bug. server.py:711 correctly writes delivery=payload.delivery.model_dump() to Mongo (verified via pymongo). _order_view() at L834-891 just doesn't include it in the returned dict. Fix: add `"delivery": o.get("delivery")` (and optionally `"discount_code": o.get("discount_code")`) to the return dict of _order_view().
